script:
Studio Apartment Ideas: Small Space Design Solutions for 2026

[warmly] Okay — so your walls are honestly the most UNDERUSED asset in a small apartment… and today we're fixing that.

First up — using wall decor to define ZONES… because in a studio, that's how you make one room feel like many.

A bookshelf or a folding screen — placed just right — creates that visual SEPARATION without blocking any light… you know?

Now — multifunctional furniture… honestly, this is where small-space living gets SMART.

Think sofa beds, storage ottomans, fold-down desks… every single piece should do at LEAST two things.

When floor space runs out… look UP — maximising vertical space with storage and wall art is a total game changer.

Floating shelves above doorways, tall bookcases, wall-mounted hooks — these are your VERTICAL solutions… keeping the floor completely clear.

[softly] Light colour and good lighting… they make a MEASURABLE difference in how big a small room actually feels.

Stick to white, soft grey, warm beige… and add ALL your personality through artwork and accessories — not bold wall colours.

A little tip I love: position your bed AWAY from the entrance and make sure each zone has its own proper lighting… it instantly feels more intentional.

And mirrors — place one OPPOSITE a window and watch the whole room open up… honestly it's like free extra square metres.

Before you hang a single thing — declutter FIRST… because wall art only shines when the rest of the space is calm and clear.

[curious] One large print or a gallery wall… which actually works BETTER in a small apartment? Let me break it down.

A single oversized print on your LARGEST wall draws the eye up and out… makes the whole space feel deliberate and gallery-like.

Or go for a TWO-piece set — gorgeous for creating that curated, gallery feel without overwhelming a small wall.

Mirror placement is genuinely the EASIEST trick in small-space design… opposite a window, always — trust me.

[excited] And for the sleeping zone — a calm two-piece Asian-inspired set feels so intentional… one of my FAVOURITES for a bedroom wall.

And for a working zone or living area… a set of THREE vintage travel prints adds real personality without taking over a small wall.

So — whether it's your sleeping zone, your living corner, or your little work spot… the RIGHT wall art makes every square metre COUNT.

Did you know styling your home doesn't have to be guesswork?

We've built a free set of Home Decor tools and styling guides…

From colour theory and design principles to gallery wall layouts and art sizing. Download them all from our site!

Find all you need to transform your home into a calming oasis!

Happy Decorating!

The room feels open, intentional and aspirational — like a spread from Kinfolk or Elle Decoration. Full bleed 16:9, no letterboxing, no clutter, no dated furniture. Muted, calm, tonal palette throughout.

checklist: Audience → "No, it's not made for kids".
Show more → AI use → "Yes" (the scenes and the people are AI-generated).
Show more → Tags → paste the Tags above.
Show more → Video language → leave "Not set". Do NOT pick a language — the captions are burned into the video, and selecting a language makes YouTube auto-add its own captions on top of them.
Show more → keep "Allow embedding" ON and "Publish to subscriptions feed and notify subscribers" ON.
Subtitles → skip (captions are burned into the video).
End screen → "Import from latest video" → Save.
Cards → add 1 Playlist card ("Home Decor Ideas & Interior Styling Tips") at ~0:30, with teaser "More home styling ideas". (Link card → skip until the channel is YPP-approved.)
Thumbnail → export your hero scene from Adobe Express as a JPG.
Visibility → Schedule for your weekly slot (e.g. Sunday 9:30am UK), one video per week; or Public now for the very first.
